vocabulary.definition: to have power and influence over others
vocabulary.example: The champion boxer dominates his opponents in the ring.
The cavalry unit rode swiftly towards the battlefield.
The horror movie filled the audience with terror.

vocabulary.definition: to yield to someone else's power or authority
vocabulary.example: The rebels were forced to submit to the king's rule.
The army launched an offensive against the enemy stronghold.

vocabulary.definition: to be forced to undergo something unpleasant
vocabulary.example: The prisoners were subjected to harsh treatment in captivity.
